ogTitle: The Adjustment Point - Center for Chiropractic & Movement
ogDescription: Personalized chiropractic protocols. We restore your ability to move. Book your appointment online.
heroDesc: Musculoskeletal care. We restore your mobility and improve your quality of life.
service1Desc: Comprehensive musculoskeletal assessment and the application of chiropractic techniques (HVLA thrust) for immediate relief and the restoration of proper body mechanics.
service2Desc: Lymphatic flow support techniques to reduce edema and improve overall lymphatic circulation.
service3Desc: Management of tendinopathies, muscle injuries, chondropathies, spinal discomfort, and injuries resulting from sports, work, or daily activities.
service4Desc: A personalized plan designed to improve mobility and effectively address kinesiophobia.
aboutSubtitle: BSc Sport Science, University of Dijon | Diploma in Chiropractic, I.A.M.A.
aboutP1: Andreas Tzemanakis possesses an extensive academic and professional background in Sports Science, physical care, and chiropractic care.
aboutP2: His methodology is centered around evaluating the unique needs of each individual and creating individualized care plans, focusing strongly on daily physical capability, mobility, and proper body mechanics.
aboutP3: Our goal is to adapt each session to every person's specific needs, lifestyle, and daily activities.
aboutPhilP1: At our center, we believe that every body is unique and requires a highly individualized approach.
aboutPhilP2: Our philosophy is built on understanding each person's needs, thoroughly assessing the body's movement and functionality, and selecting the most appropriate functional protocols for each specific case.
aboutPhilP3: Our primary goal is to support healthy movement through re-exposure and retraining the body, whether you are an active person, an athlete, or someone having daily musculoskeletal discomfort.
aboutPhilP4: We focus on personal connection, clear communication, and building a relationship of trust, ensuring every person feels they are in a space where their needs are met.
disclaimerText: The services provided at our facility involve alternative and complementary practices. They do not constitute medical procedures, and they function in a complementary capacity, without serving as a substitute for professional medical diagnosis, treatment, or monitoring.
